pixels.name: collection/gold-200.txt
pixels.input:
# Gold 200
# Warm, golden consumer-film colour: honey highlights, golden skin and leaves, cyan-blue skies, fine grain. Inspired by Kodak Gold 200, by way of Fuji X Weekly's recipe of the same inspiration.
# On the camera: white balance Daylight, exposure 0 to +2/3 (more for the airy, scanned look).
# Matched against 120 and 35mm scans of the real film: deep blacks, punchy reds; under lamplight it turns amber, as daylight film does.

highlights = -0.25

contrast = 0.15

shift_red = 0.4

mix_green = 0, -0.5, 0
mix_blue = -0.15, 0.45, 0
sharpness = -0.5
grain = 0.42
grain_size = 0.25
